Even I know a guys who was living in chawl till my large part of their ages and later due to education, they bought 1 or 2 or few have bought 3 bhk too in Mumbai or bought small multiple properties so, this is how their life upgraded on massive scale and now their parents share similar type of stories with us. 

Also similarly there are genzs whom I know in Mumbai who are not making good money. But due to good parents financial condition, they splurge money alot.

So, will advice audience to get awareness of actual stories from Mumbai from actual people and not from these fake people.
